definitions.r: r_LOS=v_rel,LOS,R16/sigma_R16,LOS,F (state-specific sigma, original E13 convention); r is not observed per-halo velocity.
definitions.C_normalized: P_{delta_cb,r_F}(K,mu) = + i mu C_F(K), original E12 direct source Fourier sign and E13 original C from E13 field P_delta_cb_rDIRECT_R16_filtered_over_i_mu_Mpc3
definitions.C_velocity: P_{delta_cb,v_rel,LOS,R16,F}/(i mu)=sigma_R16,F * C_F(K), units km/s Mpc^3. This is re-expressing original E13 direct linear velocity, not an independently measured halo relative velocity.
definitions.state_comparison: Hold exactly the same observable and units: compare C_F among F states only under state-wise r units, or compare sigma_F*C_F among states under v units; do not mix or infer physical galaxy wake-sign from one normalization.
definitions.phenomenological_two_tracer: delta_L^s=A_L(K,mu)delta_cb + c_L v_rel,LOS,R16 ; delta_E^s=A_E delta_cb + c_E v_rel,LOS,R16 with real even A_L,A_E, real unknown c_L,c_E in 1/(km/s). O(v^2) and all physical standard relativistic/evolution/magnification/tracer bias terms omitted from the illustrative contribution; NOT established Einstein-Vlasov halo response.
definitions.cross_sign: For P_LE=<delta_L delta_E*> and P_delta,v=+i mu C_velocity, the linear term is Im P_LE = mu (A_L c_E - c_L A_E) C_velocity. Swapping L<->E reverses sign. Equal A and equal c gives zero; equal A alone does not imply zero for unequal c.
definitions.relation_to_E20: E20 quadratic response S~v delta can be zero at leading order for Gaussian fields; this separate linear LOS velocity response correlates with delta at two-point order and is not subject to the E20 quadratic third-moment null. This does not prove any nonzero physical c_a from neutrino halos.
definitions.response_unit_template: Only C_velocity(K), and C_normalized(K), per each original F and four K are obtained; all A_a,c_a remain symbolic. No pretending C(K) at long modes determines original eBOSS 24D xi ell1/ell3.
definitions.possible_non_velocity_effects: Standard relativistic galaxy Doppler has a structurally analogous line-of-sight odd cross-power, but its coefficient uses galaxy bulk velocity, not automatically r_nuCDM. No attribution of all observed odd to neutrinos.
